armyRules.name: Martial Ka’tah
armyRules.description: Each time a unit from your army with this ability is selected to fight, select one readied unit (that unit is no longer readied) and one of the Ka’tah Stances below applies to it until it has finished making its attacks. Some Unique Shield Hosts grant access to a Favoured Ka’tah instead of Dacatarai/Rendax — see each Ka’tah’s own entry below.

armyRules.name: Aegis of the Emperor
armyRules.description:
The Adeptus Custodes are the shield of the Emperor: indomitable and nigh unbreakable.

Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

armyRules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
armyRules.description:
Bearers of the Pariah gene, Null Maidens are inured to psychic powers. Their Warp-smothering aura also provides limited protection for the Custodians at whose side they fight.

Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.

Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.

armyRules.name: Rendax
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE].

armyRules.name: Kaptaris
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

armyRules.name: Dacatarai
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

armyRules.name: Calistus
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.

armyRules.name: Salvus
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
  • BS.
  • Hit rolls and wound rolls.

armyRules.name: Conservai
armyRules.description:
Ka’tah Ability
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
  • Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
  • Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

abilities.name: Silent Sisterhood
abilities.description:
When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your Warlord. Friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD units have BATTLELINE. Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units have the following ability:
Creeping Dread (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a PSYKER unit or below Starting Strength makes a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

abilities.name: Assemblage of Might
abilities.description: In your Command phase, you can select one enemy unit to be a dreadful foe unit until the start of your next Command phase. Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER models’ attacks that target a dreadful foe unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

abilities.name: On Gilded Wings
abilities.description: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is unengaged, you can place that unit into strategic reserves.

abilities.name: Moritoi Ancients
abilities.description: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is at Starting Strength, that unit has +2 OC. While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below Starting Strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll Hit rolls. While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is below Half-strength, that unit’s attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Martial Mastery
abilities.description: In the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight, that unit’s melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS].

abilities.name: Talon Sortie
abilities.description: When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to charge.

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Calistus
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Calistus in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: Your unit has +2" M.

abilities.name: Wardens of the Dark Cells
abilities.description: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an objective, melee attacks that target that unit with a Strength greater than that unit’s Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Kaptaris
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Kaptaris in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: You can select one enemy unit engaged with your unit; that enemy unit makes a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll. You cannot select the same enemy unit for this effect more than once per phase.

abilities.name: Magna Imperator
abilities.description: When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, that unit’s attacks can re-roll one Hit roll and re-roll one Wound roll.

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Rendax
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Rendax in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: You can select one enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit engaged with your unit and roll one D6: on a 1-2, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 3-5, D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, 3 mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Heralds of the Throne
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units have [FIGHTS FIRST].

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Conservai
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Conservai in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: Until the end of the turn, being selected to make an advance/fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

abilities.name: Instruments of the Emperor’s Wrath
abilities.description: Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units can re-roll Charge rolls.

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Dacatarai
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Dacatarai in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a pile-in/consolidation move, -2" from that pile-in/consolidation move.

abilities.name: Gilded Guardians
abilities.description: While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) is within range of an objective, ranged attacks that target that unit with a Strength greater than that unit’s Toughness have -1 to Wound rolls.

abilities.name: Favoured Ka’tah: Salvus
abilities.description: This detachment grants access to the Favoured Ka’tah – see Salvus in Reglas de Ejército. Additional Effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have +6" R.

abilities.name: Companion’s Watch
abilities.description: While a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is within range of an objective, that unit’s attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Flare Shields
abilities.description: Friendly GRAV-ASSAULT units have the 4+ invulnerable save characteristic against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATOR SQUAD unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That VIGILATOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] or [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit has shot.
TARGET: That PROSECUTOR SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is prosecuted until the end of the turn: attacks that target a prosecuted unit have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: PURGATION SWEEP
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That WITCHSEEKER SQUAD unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s [TORRENT] attacks have +1 A, or +2 A if those attacks target a PSYKER/Battle-shocked unit.

stratagems.name: VICTORY BEFORE DEATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit within range of an objective is destroyed.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit (even though destroyed).
EFFECT: Select one objective your unit was controlling with no enemy units (excluding AIRCRAFT) within range of it; that objective is secured.

stratagems.name: ADVANCED STABILISERS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].

stratagems.name: INEVITABLE ANNIHILATION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly GRAV-ASSAULT unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That GRAV-ASSAULT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to BS and Hit rolls.

stratagems.name: HONOURED INTERRED
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has the following ability:
Honoured Interred (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: UNCEASING ONSLAUGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit ends an advance move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn, and that move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: UNSTOPPABLE MOMENTUM
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has [MOBILE].

stratagems.name: VIGIL UNENDING
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that has 2+ models.
EFFECT: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: FURY OF THE EMPEROR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit that made an ingress move this turn is selected to declare a charge.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit has +2 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR’S DOMAIN
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: You can select the objective consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

stratagems.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly TRUSTED SENTINEL unit that is below Starting Strength is selected to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks (excluding those made by CHARACTER models) have +2 A.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: GILDED CHAMPION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Any phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model has used a (Once per battle, per unit) datasheet ability.
TARGET: That model.
EFFECT: Your model can use that ability one additional time, but not in the same phase. You cannot use this stratagem on the same model more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: DUTY UNTO DEATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6 (+1 if that model is a CHARACTER model); on a 3+, do not remove that model until your unit has fought or the phase ends.

stratagems.name: INEXORABLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore modifiers to its M, Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: AT SPEAR’S LENGTH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: That fall-back move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.

stratagems.name: GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: GRIM RESPONSIBILITY
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS: CHARACTER/MONSTER].

stratagems.name: NO ESCAPE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of that enemy unit.
EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: INDOMITABLE GUARDIANS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
EFFECT: Your unit has [FIGHTS FIRST] and must be the next unit you select to fight.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.
EFFECT: Your unit is readied. You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: IMPENETRABLE BASTION
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your Movement phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units).
EFFECT: Select one objective your unit is controlling; that objective is secured.

stratagems.name: BEARERS OF HIS LIGHT
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks can ignore modifiers to Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SLAYERS OF NIGHTMARES
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a unit with a Toughness greater than this unit’s Toughness have +1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: SELFLESS SERVICE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of your opponent’s Charge phase.
TARGET: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 6" of an enemy unit (only a CHARACTER/WALKER VEHICLE unit if selecting a VEHICLE unit).
EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit: if the charge roll result is greater than 6 (after modifiers), change it to 6; when selecting charge targets, you can select enemy units within 6" of your unit and within the maximum distance.

stratagems.name: LIGHTNING WRATH
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a pile-in move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: When making that pile-in move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

stratagems.name: GOLDEN LIGHT OF THE MOIRAIDES
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make an ingress move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to Hit rolls, and enemy units cannot target your unit with snap shooting attacks.

stratagems.name: PRETERNATURAL RAPIDITY
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an advance move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: That advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot/declare a charge.

stratagems.name: TIP OF THE TALON
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of your unit have +1 to Strength.

stratagems.name: RAPID REACTIONS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit that was engaged with that enemy unit at the start of the phase.
EFFECT: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: SUPERHUMAN FOCUS
stratagems.description:
WHEN: End of any phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit that is not readied.
EFFECT: Your unit is readied. You cannot select the same unit as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle round.

stratagems.name: UNLIMITED ENDURANCE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit ends an advance move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT], and that advance move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit.
EFFECT: When an enemy model engaged with your unit selects targets, if that enemy model does not select your unit as the target of all of its attacks, that enemy model’s attacks have -1 to Hit rolls and -1 to Wound rolls.

stratagems.name: PRIME TARGET
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll one Hit roll, re-roll one Wound roll and re-roll one Damage roll.

stratagems.name: IN AURAMITE CLAD
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (excluding CUSTODIAN WARDENS units).
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
TARGET: That TRUSTED SENTINEL unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.description: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. This unit’s attacks have +1 to Hit rolls, or +1 to Hit rolls and +1 to Wound rolls if this unit targets a PSYKER/battle-shocked unit.

enhancements.name: Huntress’ Eye
enhancements.description: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. In your Movement phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit; that unit makes a Battle-shock test, with -1 to that Battle-shock roll.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.description: GRAV-ASSAULT TRANSPORT model only. When a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to make a disembark move from this model, until the end of the turn, that unit can re-roll Charge rolls and enemy units cannot target that unit with snap shooting attacks.

enhancements.name: Anti-Gravitic Mobility
enhancements.description: GRAV-ASSAULT unit only. When this unit makes a fall-back move, that fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only (one per army). This model’s melee attacks have +1 A, +1 S and +1 D.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES DREADNOUGHT model only (one per army). This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.description: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.description: SHIELD-CAPTAIN IN ALLARUS TERMINATOR ARMOUR model only. (Once per phase, per army) You can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1 CP, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Arae-Shrike
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Enemy units that are selected to make an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

enhancements.name: Celeritous Sentries
enhancements.description: TRUSTED SENTINEL unit only. (Once per phase, per unit) You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that stratagem this phase. If you do, that use is -1 CP, and that use does not prevent any uses of that stratagem on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Shroud of the Hidden Blade
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Stealth and Lone Operative.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. (Once per battle round, per army) At the start of any phase, you can select one friendly battle-shocked ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit within 9" of this model; that unit is no longer battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. At the end of a phase in which this model is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 2+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Sally Forth
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES SHIELD-CAPTAIN model only. At the start of your Charge phase, select one friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit within 6" of this model. If that unit made an advance move this turn, that advance move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Auric Eagle
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit only (excluding TERMINATOR units). This unit has +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls.

enhancements.name: Genalchemic Warding
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has Feel No Pain 5+.

enhancements.name: Unstoppable Destroyer
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. When this unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move, this unit can move up to 4", and you can select any consolidation mode for that consolidation move, regardless of that consolidation move’s Before Moving restrictions.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. Attacks that target this unit have -1 to Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

enhancements.name: Auriferous Orb
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon: Auriferous Orb [ANTI-INFANTRY/MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+, BLINDING LIGHT, DEVASTATING WOUNDS] 12" A3 BS2+ S1 AP0 D1. In your Shooting phase, when this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by this unit’s Auriferous Orb weapon; that enemy unit’s attacks have -1 to Hit rolls until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: Edge of the Blade
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. If this model made a charge move this turn, this model’s attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and re-roll Wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: Auric Exemplar
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [CLEAVE 1].

enhancements.name: Flawless Bladework
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s melee attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

enhancements.name: Pareldor’s Caducatrix
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. (Once per battle, per army) At the start of any phase, this model heals D3+3 wounds.

enhancements.name: Not a Shell Wasted
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY model only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +1 A.

enhancements.name: Bane of Abominations
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model’s attacks that target an enemy CHARACTER/MONSTER/VEHICLE unit have +1 to Wound rolls.

enhancements.name: Emperor’s Light
enhancements.description: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. This model has the following weapon: Emperor’s Light [EXTRA ATTACKS] Melee A3 WS2+ S5 AP-2 D2.

enhancements.name: Castellan’s Mark

abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.description:
FEEL NO PAIN
Some models have ‘Feel No Pain x+’ listed in their abilities. Each time a model with this ability suffers damage and so would lose a wound (including wounds lost due to mortal wounds), roll one D6: if the result is greater than or equal to the number denoted by ‘x’, that wound is ignored and is not lost. If a model has more than one Feel No Pain ability, you can only use one of those abilities each time that model suffers damage and so would lose a wound.

  • Feel No Pain x+: Each time this model would lose a wound, roll one D6: if the result equals or exceeds ‘x’, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
LEADER
Some CHARACTER units have ‘Leader’ listed on their datasheets. Such CHARACTER units are known as Leaders, and the units they can lead – known as their Bodyguard units – are listed on their datasheet.

During the Declare Battle Formations step, for each Leader in your army, if your army also includes one or more of that Leader’s Bodyguard units, you can select one of those Bodyguard units. That Leader will then attach to that Bodyguard unit for the duration of the battle and is said to be leading that unit. Each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader attached to it.

While a Bodyguard unit contains a Leader, it is known as an Attached unit and, with the exception of rules that are triggered when units are destroyed, it is treated as a single unit for all rules purposes. Each time an attack targets an Attached unit, until the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks, you must use the Toughness characteristic of the Bodyguard models in that unit, even if a Leader in that unit has a different Toughness characteristic. Each time an attack sucessfully wounds an Attached unit, that attack cannot be allocated to a CHARACTER model in that unit, even if that CHARACTER model has lost one or more wounds or has already had attacks allocated to it this phase. As soon as the last Bodyguard model in an Attached unit has been destroyed, any attacks made against that unit that have yet to be allocated can then be allocated to CHARACTER models in that unit.

Each time the last model in a Bodyguard unit is destroyed, each CHARACTER unit that is part of that Attached unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time the last model in a CHARACTER unit that is attached to a Bodyguard unit is destroyed and there is not another CHARACTER unit attached, that Attached unit’s Bodyguard unit is no longer part of an Attached unit. It becomes a separate unit, with its original Starting Strength. If this happens as the result of an attack, they become separate units after the attacking unit has resolved all of its attacks.

Each time a unit that is part of an Attached unit is destroyed, it does not have the keywords of any other units that make up that Attached unit (unless it has those keywords on its own datasheet) for the purposes of any rules that would be triggered when that unit is destroyed.

Example: If you only destroy the Bodyguard unit that is part of an Attached unit, you have not destroyed a CHARACTER unit. If you only destroy the CHARACTER unit that is part of an Attached unit, or if you destroy the whole Attached unit, you have destroyed one CHARACTER unit.

  • Before the battle, CHARACTER units with the Leader ability can be attached to one of their Bodyguard units to form an Attached unit.
  • Attached units can only contain one Leader.
  • Attacks cannot be allocated to CHARACTER models in Attached units.

Some TRANSPORT models have ‘Firing Deck x’ listed in their abilities. Each time such a model is selected to shoot in the Shooting phase, you can select up to ‘x’ models embarked within it whose units have not already shot this phase. Then, for each of those embarked models, you can select one ranged weapon that embarked model is equipped with (excluding weapons with the [ONE SHOT] ability). Until that TRANSPORT model has resolved all of its attacks, it counts as being equipped with all of the weapons you selected in this way, in addition to its other weapons. Until the end of the phase, those selected models’ units are not eligible to shoot.
